capture.reading: a capture of holding force H caps |F| at H: the wall's amplitude cannot pass H/A, nor its peak; whatever force passes H slips — a summer preload above H slips every summer, and the slip is the centre pad's travel (`102`)

not_modelled: the extruded 0.15 mm tube itself (every reading is bulk PEEK)
creep and ratcheting at the warm edge, and the time at it (preloaded cells read as if always at the hottest hour)
fatigue readings at temperature (room-temperature data used undiminished)
the capture's stress concentration and strength
plastic strain, ratcheting or shakedown past a yield
the liner's own thermal growth (102 CANNOT 12)
verdict: Sway on the adverse corner (`102`'s reversed upper whisker, R = −1): the wall's amplitude stays clear of the fatigue readings (16.2 · 30.0 · 29.3 · 48.0 · 75.7 MPa reversed-equivalent: F2 low · F1 low · F2 high · F1 high · F3) only below share 0.06 · 0.13 · 0.13 · 0.24 · 0.47 on Ti-6Al-4V (0.04 · 0.09 · 0.09 · 0.18 · 0.37 on Ta, 0.08 · 0.16 · 0.16 · 0.30 · 0.55 on beta-Ti-13Nb-13Zr) — against 23 °C yield from 0.7147, 0.5880 and 0.8300: on 6 of 6 alloys every fatigue reading switches on before the yield. By `103`'s states, the sway alone on the adverse reversed corner, the flange on the bark: past fatigue or yield on some alloy even on the kindest reading — state2_cap_rigid_bark_bond_stiff, state3_no_bearing_bond_stiff_max, state3_cap_rigid_bark_bond_stiff; clear on every alloy even on the adverse one — state1_anode_free. By `103`'s states, the sway alone on the adverse reversed corner, a Zone-3 fit: past fatigue or yield on some alloy even on the kindest reading — state2_cap_rigid_bark_bond_stiff, state3_no_bearing_bond_stiff_max, state3_cap_rigid_bark_bond_stiff; clear on every alloy even on the adverse one — state1_anode_free. Tension–tension: the one reading with a stated R (450G, 23 °C, R 0.1) holds 87.4 MPa σ_max at ≈ 1e7 — 0.87 of the tree's yield and ×1.15 (capsule edge) ⊥ ×1.10 (cambium) the warm-edge short-term yield, so where R ≥ 0.1 PEEK's fatigue is bounded by its yield. Warm edge at the capsule edge (55.0 °C), the preload alone at share 0 on the adverse grip: 72.2–90.0 MPa with the flange on the bark, 49.3–66.8 on a Zone-3 fit, against 450G's short-term yield there of 75.9 (Figure 4, ±2 digitised) ⊥ 85.1 MPa (its ratio on the tree's 100) — reached on the bark on 4–5 of 6 alloys across Figure 4's band and on 1 on the ratio reading, on a Zone-3 fit on 0 even at the band's low end. Warm edge at the cambium under the flange (46.6 °C), the preload alone at share 0 on the adverse grip: 60.4–77.4 MPa with the flange on the bark, 40.6–57.1 on a Zone-3 fit, against 450G's short-term yield there of 79.6 (Figure 4, ±2 digitised) ⊥ 89.2 MPa (its ratio on the tree's 100) — reached on the bark on 0 of 6 alloys across Figure 4's band and on 0 on the ratio reading, on a Zone-3 fit on 0 even at the band's low end. The preload is imposed by a DISPLACEMENT (the sleeve's growth over the wire), so it is self-limiting and creep relaxes it: at the capsule edge on the bark, of the 5 alloys whose preload reaches Figure 4's short-term yield at `102`'s relax floor 0.65, it falls under it once the liner keeps less than 0.441–0.617 of its modulus (Ti-6Al-4V 0.585) — and 450G's own 23 °C curve at 60 MPa already sits at 0.655 of the tree's E after 1000 h. Creep and ratcheting are not assessed. Creep: no datum at the warm edge was read. 450G's 23 °C curves (ISO 899, 1000 h, 20–60 MPa) are a LOWER bound there: at the capsule edge the adverse-grip preload lies above the top curve on 6 of 6 alloys on the bark and 1 on a Zone-3 fit (at least 2.29 % in 1000 h, no upper bound); the gentle-grip preload at least 0.62 % where a curve lies below it (5 of 12 gentle cells below the lowest curve, no bound). The capture caps |F| with ONE holding force H: it keeps the fatigue readings off the wall only while H < 8.6 N (F2 low) … 40.6 N (F3); below the first, every summer preload group slips (8 of 8 — on the bark at the capsule edge 38.8–48.3 N), and the slip is the centre pad's travel. The fatigue leg as the trigger's ground: on Ti-6Al-4V the reversed sway passes the anchor's 48 MPa in 8 of 18 state cells of `103` (both premises) — the least share 0.2969 (state3_cap_rigid_bark_bond_soft, zone3_fit) → 54.8 MPa — and F3's 75.7 only from share 0.5892. Cold edge (`102`'s thermal result, adverse grip): on the bark the wall reaches its 23 °C limit in compression on 11 of 12 alloy × temperature cells; on a Zone-3 fit -91.4 … -67.8 MPa — a seasonal swing of the wall from the warm-edge preload to that, not the sway's symmetric half.
